faq.title: Questions people ask
faq.lead: Most visitors arrive with one of these.

items.q: How can you tell if a song was made with AI?
items.a: There are a few things to listen for: vocals that never take a breath, lyrics that drift off meaning, a texture that stays the same from start to finish, endings that stop for no reason. People's songs can have all of these too. AURIS takes 47 measurements from the audio, feeds them to a model trained on 5,195 labelled songs, and shows which measurement pushed the result which way.

items.q: Does it recognise songs made with Suno or Udio?
items.a: The training set includes tracks made with Suno, Udio, MusicGen, AudioLDM, ACE-Step and DiffRhythm. New versions of these tools can fool it, so read the result as a likelihood, not a ruling.

In cross-validation it is 88.4% accurate with a ROC-AUC of 0.955, so roughly one song in nine is misclassified. The closer the probability is to the threshold (0.432), the less certain the result; the report shows this on the Certainty line.

Not on the server: the file is dropped from memory once the analysis ends, and only the result is kept for a few hours in case the same file comes back. The last audio stays in your own browser so a reload can pick up where it left off. For the FST layer, a copy goes to the mippia team's Hugging Face Space.

items.q: Is it free? Do I need an account?
items.a: It's free and there's no account. Files can be up to 30 MB. The server runs one analysis at a time, so at busy moments you wait in line, and the page shows your place.

items.q: How does a YouTube link work?
items.a: The server downloads the audio of the first two minutes and analyses it the same way as a file. YouTube blocks downloads for some videos; if that happens, upload the song as a file.

method.title: Model and validation
method.lead: LightGBM: {samples} tracks ({ai} AI-generated, {human} human-made), {features} features. Metrics use {folds}-fold cross-validation. Model files are public on Hugging Face.
method.step1: 47 features are extracted from the first 60 seconds of audio.
method.step2: LightGBM estimates probability; values above {t} are assigned to the AI class.
method.step3: Predictions from 10 additional models are compared. SHAP computes feature contributions to the primary prediction.
method.step4: wav2vec2, FST and vocal analysis results are reported separately.
method.limit1: Performance may drop on genres and generators absent from the training data.
method.limit2: Heavy processing, electronic music, microphone recordings and low audio quality can cause misclassification.
method.limit3: Cross-validation accuracy: {acc}%. This does not guarantee performance on new tracks or prove their origin.

meta.title: Privacy Policy - CrownCode
meta.description: What data CrownCode collects, how it is used and how it is protected.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: CrownCode respects user privacy. This policy explains our platform's data collection and usage practices.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.content: CrownCode platform collects minimal data to improve user experience. This includes browser information, preferred language and theme settings. We do not collect personally identifiable information.

dataUsage.title: Data Usage
dataUsage.content: Collected data is used solely to provide platform functionality. Your data is not shared with or sold to third parties. Tools that use AI (Crown Commend, Crown Dreams) do not store user data.

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.content: All data transfers are encrypted via HTTPS. Local storage (localStorage) only stores user preferences. Session data is cleared when the browser is closed.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: The platform uses essential cookies required for basic functionality. These cookies include language preference and theme settings. No third-party tracking cookies are used.
